Custom Kitchens and Cabinetry We've Built

Every project here was designed, built in our Oldsmar, FL shop, and installed by our own team. Open a project to see more photos, video, and the details.

  • Pompano Project: A waterfront home package: a walnut wet bar with lit glass display cabinets and a black stone counter, an outdoor kitchen and bar under the lanai, and a full-height backlit quartz feature panel framed in walnut.
  • St. Pete Kitchen, Pantry & Laundry (St. Petersburg, FL): A whole-house cabinetry package: a white inset-panel kitchen with a sage-green island, a white plaster-style hood, panel-ready built-in refrigerator, and a full-height quartz backsplash, plus a matching sage-green pantry and laundry room with open shelving, a hanging rod, and a folding counter over the washer and dryer.
  • Ruskin Kitchen (Ruskin, FL): A modern two-tone kitchen: matte light-gray handleless lowers and a tall oven wall, natural oak flat-panel uppers, and a blue-gray quartzite waterfall island with a matching full-height backsplash and under-cabinet lighting.
  • Modern Kitchen & Media Wall: A dark flat-panel kitchen with a thick black marble island, lit glass display cabinets, and a wine wall, plus a matching living-room media wall with backlit slatted shelving and a built-in fireplace.
  • Kitchen, Bar & Home Office (Orlando, FL): A whole-home cabinetry project designed as one system: a two-tone oak kitchen with a marble waterfall island, a paneled refrigerator wall, a wine bar, and a built-in office nook.
  • Kitchen & Two Bars: A bright two-tone kitchen with white uppers, gray lowers, and a marble waterfall island seating six, plus a gray wet bar with glass-front cabinets and a warm wood bar upstairs.
  • European Handleless Kitchen: White gloss uppers over charcoal handleless lowers, a white quartz waterfall island with seating for three, and a built-in wine fridge, in a modern European flat-panel style.
